$comment: Cron times are UTC — Vercel offers no zone. 09:00 UTC is 02:00 PDT in summer
and 01:00 PST in winter, so the tick lands overnight Pacific on the SAME
calendar day. The previous 02:00 UTC was 18:00-19:00 Pacific the PREVIOUS
day: the 'nightly' crawl read each county's page as it stood at dinner time
the day before, and any day-of-week check disagreed with the desk by a full
day. Keep in step with DISPATCH_UTC_HOUR in lib/desk-time.ts.
